question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

at top of your lungs
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"at the top of your lungs"** means to shout or scream extremely loudly. (बहुत जोर से चिल्लाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He screamed at the top of his lungs to get everyone's attention.
 
 
 
• **"Extremely loudly"** refers to making a very loud noise or sound. (बहुत जोर से)
 
 
• **Example: **The music was playing extremely loudly at the concert.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Extremely silly** (बहुत मूर्खतापूर्ण): Acting in a very foolish or ridiculous manner.
 
 
• **Example:** It was extremely silly of him to wear a clown costume to the formal event.
 
 
 
• **Pretend superiority** (श्रेष्ठता का दिखावा करना): Acting as if you are better or more important than others.
 
 
• **Example:** She always pretends superiority and looks down on others.
 
 
 
• **Exhausted** (थका हुआ): Extremely tired or worn out.
 
 
• **Example:** After the long hike, we were all completely exhausted.
